title.zh: 风险与回报 · 风险溢价

description.zh: 结果越不确定的投资，必须承诺更高的平均回报才有人愿意拿，多出来的那部分叫风险溢价；但承诺的只是平均——平均 5% 的投资，照样会有亏钱的年份，看分布比看平均数更诚实。
description.en: An investment with more uncertain results must promise a higher average return before anyone will hold it, and the extra is the risk premium; but only the average is promised — an investment averaging 5% still has losing years, and the distribution tells the truth better than the average.

aliases.zh: 平均收益不等于每年收益
aliases.en: average return is not every year’s return

reason.zh: 两种投资平均都是 5%，一个挤在 5% 附近，一个铺到 −10% 到 +20%；方差量的就是结果离平均有多散——散开意味着可能更好，也可能更糟。
reason.en: Two investments both average 5%, one clustered near 5% and one spread from −10% to +20%; variance measures how scattered the results are around the average — scattered means possibly better, and possibly worse.

reason.zh: 平均回报是所有可能结果按概率加权的期望值，到手的却是某一年真实发生的那一个；所以平均 5% 的投资里照样会冒出亏损的年份。
reason.en: The average return is the expected value — every possible outcome weighted by its probability — but what you actually get is the one outcome that happens in a given year; so an investment averaging 5% still throws up losing years.
